acts.desc:
For a year, Morgan Block saw her pilates instructor, Mary Archbold, twice a
week. She watched closely as Mary demonstrated moves and corrected poses.
And still, Morgan never noticed that Mary had a disability that should've
been very obvious.
(5 1/2 minutes)
acts.label: Prologue
Act One
acts.desc: Mary Archbold's story continues. She talks to Ira about the tactics she uses to hide her disability, and why she goes through all the effort to do it.
acts.title: There's Something About Mary

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Anton DiSclafani tells the story of her desperate search to find a stranger who left something on her porch. Anton's book The Yonahlossee Riding Camp for Girls comes out next summer. (8 1/2 minutes)
acts.title: Objects May Be Closer Than They Appear

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: For years, Jorge Salcedo was chief of security for the Cali drug cartel in Colombia. He was in charge of protecting some of the most powerful criminals in the world...until he decided to take them down. Karen Lowe tells the story.
acts.title: Seven Year Snitch
